title: Expression of c-Fos following voluntary ingestion of a novel or familiar taste in rats.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大鼠摄入新味觉时脑区c-Fos表达，属神经生物学行为实验，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: Taste neophobia, the rejection of novel tastes or foods, involves an interplay of various brain regions encompassing areas within the central gustatory system, as well as nuclei serving other functions. Previous findings, utilising c-Fos imaging, identified several brain regions which displayed higher activity after ingestion of a novel taste as compared to a familiar taste. The present study extends this analysis to include additional regions suspected of contributing to the neurocircuitry involved in evoking taste neophobia. Our data show increased c-Fos expression in the basolateral amygdala, central nucleus of the amygdala, gustatory portion of the thalamus, gustatory portion of the insular cortex and the medial and lateral regions of the parabrachial nucleus. These results confirm the contribution of areas previously identified as active during ingestion of novel tastes and expose additional areas that express elevated levels of c-Fos under these conditions, thus adding to the neural network involved in the detection and initial processing of taste novelty.
abstract_zh: 味觉新事物恐惧（taste neophobia），即对陌生味道或食物的排斥，涉及多个脑区的相互作用，包括中枢味觉系统内的区域以及执行其他功能的核团。先前的研究利用c-Fos成像技术，识别出在摄入新味道后相较于熟悉味道表现出更高活性的几个脑区。本研究扩展了这一分析，纳入了更多被认为可能参与引发味觉新事物恐惧的神经回路区域。我们的数据显示，在基底外侧杏仁核、杏仁核中央核、丘脑味觉部分、岛叶皮层味觉部分以及臂旁核的内侧和外侧区域中，c-Fos表达增加。这些结果确认了先前识别为在摄入新味道时活跃的区域的贡献，并揭示了在这些条件下表达高水平c-Fos的额外区域，从而扩展了参与味觉新颖性检测和初始处理的神经网络。
